verdict.rationale: JMAP access is well documented: session discovery, standard OAuth/Bearer auth, push, and an explicit open-standard, anti-lock-in stance. API tokens and an open-source/standards page support this. A community user confirms SMTP access via an SMTP-only app password, and another mentions an 'IMAP route' for migration. Missing for 10: any evidence of standards-based mail export (e.g. mbox/EML), first-party documentation of IMAP and SMTP client access for Fastmail itself, and independent corroboration of moving data out.
